name: Token Counter Plus
description: Token count, prompt-cache hit rate, live streaming throughput (tok/s) and cost with per-feature toggles

tokenCounter.showTokens.description: Show total token count inline in the status bar (off by default; always available on click)

tokenCounter.showCacheRate.description: Show prompt cache hit rate (cached tokens / prompt tokens)

tokenCounter.showThroughput.description: Show generation speed in tokens per second

tokenCounter.showCost.description: Show estimated cost inline in the status bar (off by default; always available on click)

tokenCounter.costPerMillionTokens.description: Fallback cost per million tokens (USD) when the model has no pricing data
